chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a young man who wanted to perform words. So, he searched far and wide for the right words to perform. He found some beautiful words that sounded amazing. He practiced each word before he was ready to perform them.

On the day of the big performance, the young man was nervous but excited. When he walked out onto the stage, he started to shake. But he searched inside himself and found the courage to perform the words.
The words came out beautifully and the audience cheered. The young man was so proud of himself for performing the words. Everyone was very impressed with his performance.
He went home that day feeling happy and proud. He knew he would always remember his special performance.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there were…
p: Once upon a time there were two friends, one was called Sam and the other was called Grace. Sam and Grace were playing happily in the garden. Then, suddenly, a brilliant light started to fill the sky. It was so big and bright that it made Sam and Grace glow.
"Look!", said Grace. "A tornado!"

The tornado moved swiftly across the sky and seemed to follow them as they ran around playing. Grace laughed and clapped her hands but Sam was scared. He thought that the tornado was too close and he started to cry.
Grace felt sorry for Sam and dropped down next to him. She put her arms around him and said, "It's okay, Sam. The tornado won't hurt us, I promise."

Sam felt much better after that and soon the two were back to playing again. The tornado had gone and everything was peaceful once more. Sam and Grace hugged each other goodbye and headed off to their homes to get a good night's sleep.

chapters.title: It was a warm summer day…
p: It was a warm summer day, and the sun was shining bright. Then all of a sudden, clouds filled the sky and the wind started to blow. Then it started to rain!

The rain was so heavy that it was like a wall of water pouring down from the sky. The horse in the field felt the rain on its hairy back and it liked it. It shook its head, enjoying the feel of the rain.
The rain kept falling and the horse continued to walk around in the field, feeling the rain all over its furry body. Soon, it was drenched with rainwater.
The horse happily trotted around and around in the field. After the rain stopped, the horse shook its body off, sending the remaining bits of rain flying away.
The sun came out once again and the horse continued feeling the warmth of the sunshine on its back. Soon, the horse's fur was completely dry.

chapters.title: Once there was a little boy…
p: Once there was a little boy called Johnny. Johnny loved aeroplanes, he watched them flying in the sky all the time.

One day Johnny went outside to play in his garden. It was cold, but he didn't mind. He ran around, chasing the butterflies and making mud pies. Suddenly he heard a loud noise. It was an aeroplane flying in the sky. Johnny looked up and waved.

The aeroplane flew away and soon it was dark. Johnny was feeling cold so he went inside his house. He gave a big shiver and he was so glad to be warm again. His dad lit the fireplace and soon it was very cosy.

Johnny lay down on the sofa, feeling warm and cosy. He waved goodbye to the aeroplane until it disappeared into the night. As he went to sleep, he started to feel happy and relaxed. He was happy he had seen an aeroplane that day.

chapters.title: Once there was a pretty girl…
p: Once there was a pretty girl, her name was Katie. One day, she went outside and was running about in her garden when suddenly she fell over and hurt her knee. She was very sad and started to whimper, but then her mummy came outside and she felt better. Mummy put a bandage on the knee and gave her a big hug.
Mummy then said to her, "Don't worry, I'm here to support you and you will feel better soon." She gave Katie a warm smile, then they went inside and had some yummy cookies.

Katie was all better after a few days and she decided to show her mummy her knee. When she lifted up the bandage, her knee was all better and the bandage was still pretty! She thanked her mummy for supporting her and gave her a big hug.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a little girl. She was only three years old. But the girl was very helpful. Every day, she found ways to provide help to her family.
One day, the girl got an exciting idea. She wanted to provide a special surprise for her family. So every day, she worked very hard. She made little gifts and put them aside.

When the end of the year arrived, the girl was ready. She gave all the gifts to her family. They were so happy! From then on, the little girl was always looking for ways to provide kindness and happiness to the people she loved.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a yellow comet in the sky. Everyone loved it because it made the night sky look so colourful. One day, the comet flew very close to the moon. The people wanted the comet to stay forever. So, they decided to bury it in the ground.
The people used many tools to dig a big hole. Then, they carefully lowered the comet inside it. They made sure it was snug and cosy. After it was buried, everyone smiled and clapped.
The people built a big yellow marker over the comet. Everyone could see it from far away. They named it "The Yellow Comet". It was a special place that everyone loved.
The end.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a little girl called Margaret who liked to explore. One day Margaret was exploring in her garden when she saw something funny – a big number sitting in the grass! Margaret went over to pick it up and noticed it smelt yummy like a treat. She quickly popped it in her mouth to find out what it tasted like.

Unfortunately, it wasn’t yummy at all; it was poison! Margaret started to feel really sick and her face went all red. She ran to find her mum who quickly took her to the doctor’s. The doctor told Margaret not to ever eat mysterious numbers again.
After a few days, Margaret learned her lesson and never ate a strange number again. She always made sure to ask a grown-up first before putting something yummy in her mouth!

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a compassionate girl named Sara. Every day she would tell a story to the children in her neighborhood. The children adored her, and each time she finished her stories, they would all smile.
One day, Sara took her stories to the park and told them to a group of 3 year olds. They were enthralled with the stories and each one of them had a huge smile on their face.

When her stories were finished, the children surrounded Sara and she gave them each a hug. They told her that they loved her stories and Sara smiled back. She was happy that so many children had been able to share and enjoy her stories.
Sara continued to go to the park every day and tell stories to the children. She was always so compassionate and caring, and the smiles on the children's faces brought her joy.
At the end of each day, the children would thank Sara for the stories and wave goodbye. She would wave back, feeling content and loving that she had shared her stories with them.

chapters.title: Once there was a frog named…
p: Once there was a frog named Lulu. She wanted to go on an adventure. So Lulu jumped out of her pond and started to bounce down the trail.
Lulu saw a rabbit in the grass and hopped closer to take a look. She was confused - was he her friend or should she be scared?
Then suddenly - hop, hop - a big frog appeared! "My name is Finny," he said with a smile. "Come play with me!"
So, Lulu and Finny bounced around and down the trail, laughing and jumping and having lots of fun.
Lulu was no longer confused, she was happy to have a friend and was excited to go on more adventures with Finny. They bounced off down the trail, into the sunset!

chapters.title: John wanted something special He asked…
p: John wanted something special. He asked his mom to help him find it. Mom said she knew someone with deep wisdom. She told John that he could learn something powerful if he went to visit this person.
John found the man, and the man smiled and introduced himself. The man said he could replace John's old toy with something special. He waved his hands and a beautiful shiny stone appeared!
John was so excited. He thanked the wise man and ran home. When he got there, he put the stone on the shelf and looked at it every day. Whenever John felt sad, he stared at the stone and felt better.
John now knew the power of deep wisdom and he was happy that he went to visit the wise man.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. He was very curious. One day, Tim ventured into a big, dark room. As Tim walked in, he could feel his muscles trembling. He had never seen a room as big and dark as this one.

Tim had never seen a room with so many switches. Everywhere he looked, he saw switches on the walls and in the corners. He was very excited and tried to press each switch he saw. But none of them worked. He tried again and again, but nothing changed.

Tim kept trying and eventually, he came across one special switch. He pressed it and, at once, a big light came on. Bright yellow light filled the room, and Tim smiled in joy. He was very persistent and he was rewarded.

As he ran out of the room, Tim felt very happy. He had conquered his fear and he had found a special switch that could turn on the lights. He learned that being persistent can help you achieve great things.

chapters.title: Once there was a small boy…
p: Once there was a small boy named Tommy. Tommy was very tired and he wanted to go to sleep. So Tommy's mommy gave him some string and told him that if he buried it in the ground, then he will get rest. Tommy was very excited, so he ran outside and started digging in the dirt.
Soon the hole was big enough and Tommy put the string in it. Then he patted the dirt down on top of the string and stood back to look at his work. It was finished!

Tommy was so tired that he sat right down in the dirt and fell asleep. Later, when Tommy woke up, he was so happy that he had found a way to get some rest. He picked up the string, thanked his mommy, and went inside.
The end.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a boy who wanted to play basketball. He begged his mum and dad to come outside and play with him. He said please, please, please!
His mum and dad said OK and they all went outside. The boy had a very long basketball. It was way bigger than his mum and dad's!
He dribbled the basketball up and down the long driveway. He tried to run very fast, but he kept tripping over the basketball!
His mum and dad laughed a lot and they said, "It's OK! You'll get better at dribbling the basketball."
The boy smiled and kept trying, until he was very tired. He gave the big, long basketball one more try and finally he succeeded! He dribbled all the way up the driveway, triumphantly!
Mum and dad cheered and said, "Well done! You kept trying and now you know how to dribble the basketball."
The boy felt very proud of himself and smiled a big smile. He was so happy to have finally succeeded in dribbling the long basketball.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a little girl named Lucy. She was only three years old. Lucy loved to explore her house but today she was feeling scared.
She tip-toed through her house until she found the kitchen. She was scared of the kitchen because it was so dark and brown. She could hear strange noises coming from inside.
Lucy held her teddy bear tight and stepped into the kitchen. She was scared but she was brave too. Lucy walked over to the big brown door and opened it.
Suddenly out jumped the biggest, softest, fluffiest cat she had ever seen! Lucy was so surprised she screamed out loud. Then she burst out laughing.
The cat was very friendly and loved to be tickled. Lucy had never been so happy before! She knew she would never be scared of the kitchen again.

chapters.title: Once there was a little girl…
p: Once there was a little girl who loved to swim. She swam in the lake every day with her friends. Her favorite part was when they would all dive in and swim under the big, white veil. It was like swimming in a cloud!

One day while they were swimming they saw a fish. It was so big and so beautiful! The girl was so generous, she wanted to share the amazing experience with her friends. She used her veil to softly cover the fish so it wouldn't get scared. And then she swam away very slowly so that her friends could get a good look.

The little girl loved her generous nature and was sure that the fish did too. Every day she swam in the lake and visited the fish. After all the wonderful memories, this was the best swimming experience of her life!

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a nice little puppy. He was always so happy, playing with his friends and wagging his tail. One day, the puppy's best friend got very sick. The puppy felt so sad and didn't know what to do. He started to weep. He wept and wept until his mommy saw him. His mommy told him it was going to be ok and hugged him tight. She took him to see his friend the next day, and the puppy's friend was all better. The puppy was so happy he started to run and jump around, barking and playing with his friend again. They were best friends forever and always had nice days together. The end.

chapters.title: Once there was a little girl…
p: Once there was a little girl named Sally. She was only three years old. She had a mommy and daddy who loved her very much. They were very compassionate.

One day Sally was playing in her backyard. Suddenly she heard a noise coming from near her neck. It sounded like someone was calling her name. She looked around but she couldn't see who was calling her.
Sally became scared and started to cry. Her mommy heard her cries and ran outside. She quickly saw what was happening. On Sally's neck there was a little bird. The bird was calling to Sally.
Sally's mommy smiled at Sally and picked up the little bird. She told Sally that the bird was calling for help. She was so happy that Sally had been so compassionate to help the bird.
Sally's mommy told her that caring for others was such an important lesson. She hugged Sally and said that she was very proud of her. From that day Sally and the bird became the best of friends.

chapters.title: Once there was a big pool…
p: Once there was a big pool. The water was shiny and one day a bell began to ring. Everyone was so excited because it meant that it was time to have fun.

The children ran to the pool and dashed in. They laughed and splashed around in the big pool. One of the kids found a big floaty and floated around for a while. Then they started playing games like diving for toys and having races.
When the bell rang again, it was time to get out and dry off. Everyone was so tired from the fun they had been having. They dried off know that they had had a great time in the big pool.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a charming little girl called Lola. She loved to spin very quickly in circles, which made her laugh and giggle. Lola spun around the room so fast her toes flew up into the air!

She kept on spinning and spinning until her toes were all a jumble! She stopped and bent over to try to sort out her toes. But as soon as Lola tried to put them in the right places she started spinning again - just for fun.
When Lola felt ready to slow down, she held out her arms and spun round and round until she came to a stop. She looked down and saw that her toes were all in the right places- a perfect pattern!

Lola kept spinning, happy in the knowledge that her toes looked charming and tidy. She spun and spun and spun, until she was too tired to spin any more. A happy smile filled her face and Lola knew that spinning was her favorite game.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a little girl. Her name was Suzy and she had a very special igloo. She set it up in her backyard, and she liked to play inside it every day.
One day, Suzy noticed something smelling yucky inside the igloo. She thought it must be something smelly, and she didn't like it at all.

So she decided to take a look and see what was causing the smell. She peeked around inside the igloo until she spotted a smelly old skunk. He was hiding in one of the corners and he looked very unhappy.

Suzy thought it would be best to get rid of the skunk, so she opened the door of the igloo and very gently shooed him away. He quickly ran off with his smelly tail between his legs and Suzy was very happy!
She was able to go back to playing in her igloo without the smelly old skunk. She had set up her igloo again, and she was ready to have all sorts of fun.

chapters.title: One day there was a pebble…
p: One day, there was a pebble in the garden. It was very small and round. The pebble was very tired and was rolling around in circles.
Suddenly, a rabbit appeared. She wanted to play with the pebble, so she hopped over to it and pushed it around. The pebble went far away and got stuck in the ground.
The rabbit tried to get it out, but she couldn't. In frustration, she dug around the pebble and destroyed it. The pebble was broken into tiny pieces and scattered in the garden.
The rabbit was sad. She had wanted the pebble to play with, not to destroy it! But the pebble was gone forever.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a small boy named Tom. Tom was a very strong boy, but he did not know how to use his feet. He tried to use them to run and jump, but he kept falling over.
One day, Tom asked his mom to help him learn how to use his feet. His mom was so proud of him and taught him how to use his feet.
First, she showed him how to stand on his own two feet. Then she showed him how to walk. Tom practiced and practiced until he could walk without falling over.
Next, Tom learned how to jump. He practiced and practiced until he could jump high and move his feet quickly. He was so happy and proud of himself!
Tom was so strong and he knew how to use his feet. Now he could run and jump and have so much fun playing with his friends. Everyone was amazed at how much Tom had learned!

chapters.title: Once there was a boy who…
p: Once there was a boy who was only three. His mom and dad said to him, "We dare you to go outside the house". The young boy was a bit scared because he had never seen the outside world before. But he was brave and accepted the dare. He grabbed his mom's hand and cautiously opened the door.

When the boy looked out, he saw a huge world. There were so many humans walking around and all the buildings were towering into the sky. He saw a small park nearby and it looked so inviting. Without thinking twice, he ran towards it.

When he reached the park, the boy saw dirt, sticks, and leaves scattered everywhere. He was so excited to start playing in the huge pile of dirt, but then his mom warned him. "Don't touch the dirt, it is filthy". The boy had never heard that word before and he asked his mother what it means. She explained that things that are filthy are not clean and can make us sick.

Disappointed, the young boy reluctantly stepped away from the dirt and started playing with the leaves instead. He had so much fun that he didn't even realize it had gotten dark outside. Finally, his mom called him back inside and they both had a good laugh at the adventure they had gone through.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a rude girl called Helen. One day, Helen was playing with her scissors. She wanted to cut a picture of her best friend, Jack. But as she cut, her scissors got stuck!
Helen was frustrated and she shouted at Jack. She was very rude to him. Jack didn't like it and he ran away.
Helen chased after him, holding her scissors. But Jack was too fast and he managed to escape. So Helen stopped running and just stood still.
She couldn't believe she had been so rude. Suddenly, she saw Jack a few metres away, looking at her sadly. Helen slowly smiled and waved at him. Jack smiled back and waved.
The situation had ended. Jack and Helen both realised that being rude wasn't nice. They hugged and made up, then went off to play together.
